label: Five-fold evaluation · November 16, 2026

source.title: MediPFN for StatsArena — Five-Fold Evaluation and Random Forest Comparison

aggregation: Directly transcribed pooled results. All 2,000 tables receive equal weight; 1,000 mechanisms contribute two independent tables each. Configurations are weighted by table counts. No averaging of the earlier two-fold report.
variance_definition: Mean over mechanisms of (estimate₁ − estimate₂)² / 2. The directly reported Variance is used, not a square of rounded SE.
protocol: Both methods use the same observed tables and treatment-stratified five-fold assignments. RF: scikit-learn 1.7.2, 200 trees, min_samples_leaf=5, 50 complete-row bootstrap replicates with new five-fold splits and percentile endpoints. All 2,000 runs per method completed.
timing: Mean seconds per table. MediPFN uses GPU inference excluding model loading and warm-up; RF uses one CPU core and includes all 50 bootstrap replicates. These are not matched-hardware timings.
caveat: The MediPFN checkpoint and its error head/calibration are unchanged from their two-fold training; this is observed five-fold performance, not newly calibrated five-fold intervals.
